capabilities: Create notes for movies, TV shows, games, albums and books
Download, resize and embed cover art
Look up word definitions with pronunciation, synonyms and antonyms
Turn selected list lines into links to the created notes
Generate collection pages with Bases views
disambiguation: Not for annotating media files already in the vault; it fetches metadata from online sources to create new notes.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list, so installation goes through BRAT; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later because API keys are stored in the Obsidian Keychain. The README warns that Google Books and TMDB terms limit keeping returned data in notes, and that MusicBrainz requests are spaced at least one second apart.
intentEvidence: It is a port of the obsidian-tools command-line tool, and writes the same notes it does.
problem: Notes about films, series, games, albums and books have to be assembled by hand from a lookup site, including metadata and cover art.

summary: Creates notes for movies, TV shows, games, albums, books and word lookups, with cover art, tags and collection pages.
